LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusPond.label: lotus pond
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusPond.description: The core of Qinghe's Flower Court, used to tune Four-Season Resonance. Qinghe herself can establish the current resonance with the Four-Season Flower Gods here.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusPond.comps.1.noAssignablePawn: The lotus pond can only be assigned to Qinghe.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LostMusicScoreFragment.label: lost score fragment
LanguageData.MX_QH_LostMusicScoreFragment.description: A damaged and difficult-to-read Qinghe score fragment. It can be assembled at an art bench into a random book, with a chance to become a lost Qinghe skill book.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SkillBook.label: Qinghe skill book
LanguageData.MX_QH_SkillBook.description: A book recording old scores. When Qinghe reads it, she can learn the matching skill node; other readers can still read it like an ordinary book.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Book.label: Lotus Rain Pavilion artistry
LanguageData.MX_QH_UnfinishedLotusRainPavilionOpera.d: An unfinished Lotus Rain Pavilion verse manuscript.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Weapon_FlowerBell.label: Flower Bell
LanguageData.MX_QH_Weapon_FlowerBell.description: An instrument that has accompanied Qinghe since childhood. It can produce sounds that pierce the mind, and when infused with flower words, it can carry special power. /n/nIt can enter resonance mode; resonant notes deal triple damage to buildings. This compensates for buildings being unable to receive status effects.
